trail.name: Lake Solitude via Round-trip Shuttle
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS West Shore Boat Dock marker. Area forecast reference for the walking start after the crossing; not navigation or uniform conditions on the higher route.
trail.planningNote: NPS publishes this as the shorter shuttle-boat hike. Long, steep mountain hike: check current conditions with a backcountry ranger. Allow extra time for boat travel and queues; the dock-area forecast does not represent the higher route.

accessRoute.label: Round-trip shuttle + hike
accessRoute.start: East Shore Boat Dock for the crossing; hike from West Shore Boat Dock
accessRoute.returnPlan: Hike back to the west dock, then take the return boat to the east dock.
accessRoute.distanceScope: West-dock hiking out and back. Boat crossings and parking-to-dock access are not included.

comparison.summary: Related public Lake Solitude route with different published mileage. Confirm its access before comparing it with this NPS shuttle itinerary.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS activity-map configuration for the Lake Solitude shuttle-boat itinerary.

comparison.note: Connected NPS-origin USGS trail segments from the west-dock corridor to Lake Solitude and back total 15.024 mi versus NPS 14.4 mi. Boat travel and dock connectors are excluded. This is route-corridor evidence, not a navigation track.

photo.alt: A small lake surrounded by mountains reflects the mountainous scenery on its calm surface.
photo.permissionNote: Reviewed the official NPS page and its NPS photographer credit; no third-party restriction is displayed. Retain attribution and source; no endorsement is implied.
